notes.title: Demo - Festival Results
notes.content:
[b]Steam Next Fest has come to an end![/b]

Total additions to wishlist - 493
Total players - 225

Also we received a lot of feedback, and with a big surprise for us Very positive! Even though this is the very first look at the game.

[b]We have compiled and highlighted the most basic of the feedback and are sharing the details with you:[/b]
- Swordswoman is not the only character in the game's story, as you may have noticed at the beginning of the game (2 other characters are temporarily unavailable, one of which uses ranged combat), so there will be other characters that will be unlocked as you progress through the game's story,
- Crosshair is only used for keyboard and mouse controls, and automatic targeting will be used for the controller and SteamDeck,
- Some creatures, mini-bosses and level bosses may have defenses against different types of controls.
- Inside the game store will offer to buy sets of weapons and appearance for characters, perhaps something else ща Activity Points, which you will receive in the future for passing the game lore and challenges.
- Donate store will not be, as the game will be distributed on a one-time purchase.
- Weapons will be changed, but only cosmetically. You will be able to pump your character in other ways in the future.
- Skill change is in the plans, but there is a possibility that it won't be in the final version of the game. We can't confirm this at the moment. The concept of the game is still in development and at the stage of comprehension.
- We have not yet had time to do English voice acting for the game, it is in process.
- There will be items in the game, as well as a combat inventory that you will be able to fill before starting a level, as well as collect potions during the game and use at your discretion.

We are working on improving the quality of game aspects and mechanics, and will be paying more attention to the points you mentioned. Due to this, we have prioritized:
- Improve the combat system;
- Improve animations.

This is the first thing we will do, after that we will continue to add game mechanics and start adding the game's story. Right now we are focused on improving the quality of the gameplay, especially in particular the combat system. So that first of all the combat system works like clockwork, then we will be able to add to the roster quickly. And there is already progress here.

[b]If you have any suggestions, you can tell us about them right here. We will try to take them into account in future updates.[/b]

Additionally, we would like to inform you that the Demo version has been deactivated and the game has been sent for revision. Thank you again for your participation in Steam Next Fest and feedback.

We will inform you about the new stage of access to the demo version in the news.

[b]See you soon![/b]

notes.title: TiaDar Update - October 19, 2024
Demo game available!
notes.content:
We would like to thank everyone for their participation in testing the Prototype of the game and are happy to announce the release of the early demo!

We have made great strides and progress in these 4 months.

[b]Please be advised that this demo is not a finalized version![/b]

Everything you will see will probably be changed more than once, new mechanics will be added, bugs will be fixed, new game content will be added, and something will be removed from the game.

You can report all the bugs you find in the official community of the game developers, as well as there to share your suggestions and feedback.

We have tried to optimize the demo version of the game as much as possible, but we do not guarantee at this stage of game development absolute stability and performance of the game on any technical parameters of your computer. We recommend you to stick to the Minimum System Requirements of the game.

[b]Enjoy the game![/b]
